title: Maria, from the side
logline: Maria in the lawn chair in July from the side, the braid gray now, a mug, the ramp beside her, the bird on the piling behind her not looked at. The strip's Maria at fifty-one, drawn the way the strip drew her: without a line of dialogue.

panels.composition: A woman with a gray braid in an old lawn chair on a dock in July from the side, a mug in her hands, a plank ramp beside her, a small rainbow bird on a piling behind her unlooked at.

characters.pose: in the chair, from the side
